paragraphs.source_en: Some of the initial companies like RCA and CBS are well known, to be sure. But like FDR and JFK, these companies were well known before they dropped their names in favor of initials. Which companies are likely to grow faster? Again, the name companies. To test this point, we conducted a survey of both "name" and "initial" companies using a Business Week subscriber list. The results show the value of a name. The average awareness of the "initial" companies was 49 percent. The average awareness of a matched group of "name" companies was 68 percent, 19 percentage points higher. What drives big companies into committing corporate suicide? For one thing, the top executives have seen the company's initials on internal memos
